Figure 3a, "Orography Factor O for hills and ridges", plots Orography Factor O (1.00 to 1.40) against X/Lu and X/Ld (-1 to 1.5) with three curves labelled "Steep slope < 1/3.3", "Moderate slope = 1/5" and "Shallow slope ≤ 1/10", and a small inset marked z, 0.5z, 0.5Ld, Lu, Ld, -X, +X and "Orography significant in shaded area". Figure 3b, "Orography Factor O for cliffs and escarpments", plots the same factor against X/Lu (-1 to 2.5) with the same three slope curves and an inset marked 1.5Ld, with the note "(interpolation between curves may be used)".
fixes.reason: The image shows two graphs of Orography Factor O with three labelled slope curves each and inset sketches.
fixes.evidence: Printed captions Figure 3, 3a and 3b, axis values, curve labels and inset labels visible in the image.
